name: Ardón (Spain)
description: Square flag horizontally divided white over red with a broad white upper part, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Ardón (a castle on red above grapes).
history: Municipal flag of Ardón; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Ardón arms — castle on red above grapes
castle and crown of the arms
